description: This PHP source file defines the EmpDirectDebit entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_directdebit' database table and includes properties for direct debit details such as routing number, account details, amount, and related employee salary. The class includes constants for account types and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: EmpDirectDebit
classes.description: Entity class representing employee direct debit information stored in the 'hs_hr_emp_directdebit' database table. It includes fields for routing number, account info, amount, account type, and transaction type, with relationships to EmployeeSalary.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: getSalary
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSalary object associated with this direct debit.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Associates an EmployeeSalary object with this direct debit.

methods.name: getRoutingNumber
methods.description: Returns the routing number for the bank account.

methods.name: setRoutingNumber
methods.description: Sets the routing number for the bank account.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount for the direct debit.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for the direct debit.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the type of bank account (SAVINGS, CHECKING, OTHER).

methods.name: setAccountType
methods.description: Sets the type of bank account.
